title: bash-camp secrets manifest
description: secrets/manifest.json: which files of secrets/ go where. Validated strictly by bootstrap.py; this schema only drives editor completion.

source.description: File or directory inside secrets/, relative to it.

target.description: Where install copies it: a path under the home directory. Whatever was there before is backed up and restored on uninstall.

load.description: Instead of placing the file, export its KEY=value lines into every shell.

mode.description: Octal permissions of the placed file (of every file, for a directory; directories get 700).

local_only.description: Never shipped to remote hosts by `camp pitch HOST`; skipped wherever the source is absent.
